UNWIND-PROTECT was losing a coupla days ago. At that time the losing cases
were (even in interpreted code):
 (PROG () (UNWIND-PROTECT (RETURN T) (PRINT 'FOO)))
 (UNWIND-PROTECT (ERR) (PRINT 'FOO))
 (SETQ A 0.) (UNWIND-PROTECT (PROGN (SETQ A 1.) (TYIPEEK)) (PRINT 'FOO))^G
Cases 2 and 3 were fixed (apparently) by RWK's patch. Case 1 still loses.
Can someone please look at this? Thanx. -kmp
